scenario.title: 品牌出包，緊急應變
scenario.context: 危機發生時，常會同時講「過去的原因」和「現在的結果」：「如果我們當初有檢查，現在就不會陷入這種困境」。這種跨時間的假設是混合條件句，結合了第 45 和第 64 單元的兩種條件句。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: We have a problem. The new packaging has a typo on 10,000 boxes, and it's all over social media.
lines.zh: 我們有問題了。新包裝有一萬個盒子印錯字，而且已經傳遍社群。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Oh no. If we had done one more proofread, we wouldn't be in this mess now.
lines.zh: 糟了。如果我們當初多校對一次，現在就不會陷入這團混亂。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Let's focus on damage control. What are our options?
lines.zh: 我們先專注在止損。有哪些選項？

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: We could post an apology with a joke. People might find it charming.
lines.zh: 我們可以發一篇帶點幽默的道歉文，大家可能會覺得很可愛。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: And offer a discount code. If we weren't a small brand, it'd be harder. But our customers are loyal.
lines.zh: 再提供折扣碼。如果我們不是小品牌，會比較難處理，但我們的客人很忠誠。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Good. I've been putting out fires all morning, but this one we can turn into something positive.
lines.zh: 好。我整個早上都在救火，但這個我們可以轉成正面的事。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: The apology post went viral. Sales actually went up!
lines.zh: 道歉文爆紅了，銷量反而上升！

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Unbelievable. If we hadn't made the typo, we wouldn't be this popular now.
lines.zh: 難以置信。如果我們沒打錯字，現在就不會這麼紅。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Let's not make it a strategy, though. Honestly, that printer was the last straw.
lines.zh: 不過別把它當成策略。說真的，那家印刷廠是壓垮駱駝的最後一根稻草。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Agreed. They've made mistakes three times this year.
lines.zh: 同意，他們今年已經出錯三次了。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: The writing was on the wall. We should switch vendors.
lines.zh: 徵兆早就很明顯了，我們應該換廠商。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I'll start looking for new printers tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我明天開始找新的印刷廠。

patterns.en: Let's focus on what we can control.
patterns.zh: 我們專注在能控制的事。

patterns.en: We need to get ahead of this.
We'll issue a statement by noon.
How do we prevent this from happening again?
It could have been much worse.

chinglish.wrong: If we checked it, we won't have this problem now.
chinglish.right: If we had checked it, we wouldn't have this problem now.
chinglish.why: 過去的原因（had checked）+ 現在的結果（wouldn't have），這就是混合條件句。

chinglish.wrong: If we had checked it, we wouldn't have had this problem now.
chinglish.right: If we had checked it, we wouldn't have this problem now.
chinglish.why: 有 now 表示結果在現在，主要子句用 would + 原形，不是 would have + p.p.。

chinglish.wrong: We must extinguish the fire quickly.
chinglish.right: We need to put out this fire quickly. / We need to do damage control.
chinglish.why: extinguish 很正式而且字面上是真的滅火；職場救火用 put out fires。
「最後一根稻草」是 straw，不是 grass。

grammar.title: 混合條件句
grammar.oneLiner: 過去的假設 → 現在的結果：If + had + p.p., would + 原形；現在的假設 → 過去的結果：If + 過去式, would have + p.p.。
whenToUse: 過去原因 → 現在結果（最常用）：If we had checked, we wouldn't be in trouble now.
現在（長期）狀態 → 過去結果：If I weren't so shy, I would have spoken up yesterday.
常見線索：主要子句有 now / today / still，if 子句有 yesterday / last year。
複習 type 2：If I had time, I'd help.（現在→現在）
複習 type 3：If I had known, I would have helped.（過去→過去）
混合條件句就是把 type 2 和 type 3 的兩半交叉組合。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 第 45 和 64 單元學會了 type 2 和 type 3 之後，台灣人常以為條件句只有這兩種固定組合。但真實生活中，過去的決定常影響現在的狀態：「如果我當初念設計，現在就是設計師了」。中文用「當初」「現在」就能說清楚，英文則要把兩個子句的時態拆開各自處理。

examples.correct: If I had studied design, I would be a designer now.
examples.incorrect: If I studied design, I would have been a designer now.
examples.note: 過去原因 + 現在結果。

examples.correct: If she hadn't moved to Taipei, we wouldn't know each other.
examples.note: 過去沒搬 → 現在不認識。

examples.correct: If I weren't afraid of heights, I would have gone bungee jumping last summer.
examples.note: 現在的個性 → 過去的結果。

examples.correct: If we had left earlier, we'd be there by now.
examples.note: by now 是現在結果的線索。

examples.correct: If I had known, I would have told you.
examples.note: 這是一般的 type 3（過去→過去）。

quiz.question: If I had taken that job, I ___ in Tokyo now.
quiz.explanation: 過去原因 + 現在結果：would + 原形。

quiz.question: If we ___ the file, we wouldn't be in trouble now.
If I weren't so busy, I would ___ come to your party last night.
quiz.explanation: 現在狀態 + 過去結果：would have + p.p.。

quiz.question: If she hadn't helped me, I ___ this job today.
quiz.explanation: today 表示現在的結果：wouldn't have（擁有）。

quiz.question: If we had left on time, we ___ be there by now.
quiz.explanation: by now → 現在結果：would + 原形。

slang.usage: 出事後採取行動，把負面影響降到最低。do damage control。

examples.en: The PR team is doing damage control after the CEO's comments.
examples.zh: 執行長發言後，公關團隊正在止損。

examples.en: I said something awkward at dinner and spent the rest of the night on damage control.
examples.zh: 我晚餐時說錯話，剩下整晚都在補救。

slang.usage: 一直在處理緊急的小問題，沒時間做重要的事。

examples.en: I've been putting out fires all day.
A good manager prevents fires instead of just putting them out.
examples.zh: 好主管會預防問題，而不只是救火。

slang.meaning: 壓垮駱駝的最後一根稻草
slang.usage: 讓人忍無可忍的最後一件事。That was the last straw.

examples.en: When he missed the third deadline, that was the last straw.
examples.zh: 他第三次錯過截止日，那是最後一根稻草。

examples.en: The noise at 3 a.m. was the last straw. I'm moving.
examples.zh: 凌晨三點的噪音是最後一根稻草，我要搬家。

slang.meaning: 不祥的預兆、明顯的徵兆
slang.usage: the writing was on the wall = 早就看得出會出事。源自聖經故事。

examples.en: The writing was on the wall when sales dropped for six months.
examples.zh: 銷量連掉六個月時，徵兆就很明顯了。

examples.en: She saw the writing on the wall and found a new job.
examples.zh: 她看出苗頭不對，就找了新工作。

review.question: That was the week ___ everything went wrong.
review.explanation: 複習第 87 單元：時間用 when。

review.question: We're committed to ___ (fix) the problem.
review.explanation: 複習第 86 單元：committed to + V-ing。

review.question: It's essential that the statement ___ out by noon.
review.explanation: 複習第 84 單元：It's essential that + 原形。

review.question: A: Didn't anyone proofread it? B: (沒有) ___
review.explanation: 複習第 80 單元：否定事實用 No。

review.question: It was the printer ___ made the mistake, not us.
review.explanation: 複習第 72 單元：It was… that。

review.question: By Friday, we ___ all the boxes.
review.explanation: 複習第 56 單元：未來完成式。

review.question: We'll ___ the printer redo the whole order.
review.explanation: 複習第 24 單元：have + 人 + 原形。

review.question: If we had hired more staff last year, we ___ so overworked now.
review.explanation: 過去原因 + 現在結果：wouldn't be。
